agents.name: completeness
agents.description: Completeness reader in the /build CLOSE wave: grades the diff against the brief committed as the branch first commit. Read-only.

agents.name: write-brief
agents.description: The /build brief writer: one unit's brief from its ticket, plan sections, or request, checked and classed. Never commits.

agents.name: builder
agents.description: The /build builder: one part of a unit from its brief, on the model the spawn passes.

agents.name: fixer
agents.description: The /build fix-round agent: checks each table row at the code, fixes it with a test, records each row.

agents.name: silent-failures
agents.description: Silent-failure reader in the /build CLOSE wave at R1 and above: swallowed errors, bad fallbacks, unobservable degrade paths. Read-only.

agents.name: gate-warden
agents.description: Push-pipeline auditor over the push_stats step: drift, cache, refusals, retry cost. Operator-invoked; read-only.

agents.name: hand-test
agents.description: Runs the brief's hand test block in the session tree and records pass or fail. Edits no code.

agents.name: prior-art
agents.description: Prior-art sweeper: reuse, generalize, consolidate, or justified-new verdicts with evidence before a new module is designed. Report-only.

agents.name: answer-question
agents.description: Settles one question a build-graph agent raised from the code, brief, plan, docs, tracker or decision principles, naming its source, or refuses to the operator with what it searched. Graph runs only; read-only on the repo.

agents.name: review
agents.description: Generalist reader of one diff in the /build CLOSE wave, and the whole review at R0; its Rubric is the one finding block every reader uses. Read-only.

agents.name: security
agents.description: Security reader in the /build CLOSE wave at R2: rule compliance and concrete exploitability. Read-only on the code.

agents.name: link-slices
agents.description: The links between a fix round's draft slices, for fixers that run at once: what one slice's fix changes that another slice's files use. Read-only but for its links file.

agents.name: simplifier
agents.description: Reads a design or a diff for simplification, efficiency, altitude, encapsulation, cohesion, and contract defects. Read-only.

agents.name: write-tests
agents.description: Writes and mutation-proves batches of three or more tests for code someone else wrote, from its slice of the brief. A database slice runs as a Claude spawn in its own worktree; every other slice runs on Codex in the build writers worktree.
